name: Shortlisted
meaning: You saved this program but have not started.
student_next_action: Review requirements and start your checklist.

name: Applied
meaning: You submitted the application on the university portal.
student_next_action: Track status and watch for document requests.

name: Review
student_next_action: Keep checking email and portal; prepare for a possible test or interview.

name: Decision
meaning: Admission, rejection or waitlist result is available.
student_next_action: If admitted: accept, then blocked account and visa.

name: Admission Decision
meaning: Result expected after the review period.

name: Not Started
meaning: You have not started this application yet.

name: High Priority
student_next_action: Show in red; send reminders at 45, 30, 14, 7 and 3 days.

name: Medium Priority
student_next_action: Show in amber; remind at 90 and 60 days.

name: Low Priority
student_next_action: Show in green; remind at 120 days.

name: Overdue
student_next_action: Tell the student clearly and suggest the next intake.
